provenance.note: Zigbee2MQTT exposes these as state, power and energy; the bridge's zigbee2mqtt driver maps by property name, the cluster ids here are the underlying ZCL facts. Only metering plugs report power/energy - a plain on/off plug simply never publishes them. The Metering cluster's raw multiplier/divisor varies by vendor; Zigbee2MQTT normalises the energy property to kWh.

source: Zigbee Cluster Library specification: On/Off cluster (0x0006, onOff attribute), Electrical Measurement cluster (0x0B04, activePower) and Metering cluster (0x0702, currentSummationDelivered) - the standard clusters of a metering smart plug.
